प्यै, and प्याय् प्यय् (developed out of vedic पी), i. 1, Ātm. To be exuberant, to increase.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. प्यान.
 II. पीन, Fat, bulky, corpulent,

.
 III. प्यायित.
 --With the prep. आ आ,
 1. To increase,
. To cause to prosper, 5, 508. आपीन, Full, abounding in milk,

. आप्यायित, Fattened, strengthened, Pañc. 9, 4.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To increase.
 --Caus. To refresh, to animate,

.
 --Akin are probably A.S. faett; O.H.G. feizt.
